title: Biohazard waste handling
description: Segregating, autoclaving, and disposing of biohazardous waste streams. Annual refresher required.

quizData.question: Solid biohazard waste goes into…
options: Clear plastic bag with a sticker

quizData.question: Autoclave indicator tape that turned dark stripes confirms…
options: The bag reached process temperature; sterility still requires correct cycle time + load

quizData.question: Used scalpel blades go in…
options: A rigid sharps container, no exceptions
Wrapped in tape in the trash

quizData.question: Liquid biological waste before sink disposal must be…
options: Treated with bleach (10% final, ≥ 30 min) or autoclaved

quizData.question: Mixed waste (biohazard + chemical) goes…
options: Routed through EH&S as a separate hazardous-waste stream — never into the autoclave
